s: Debarim happoselim bearbaat hamminim ubo k"[d] seipim: kol arbaat hamminim shehaya echad mehen shaul beyado o gazul o ganub, ben miyyisrael ben minnokri, ap al pi shekkebar nityaashu habbealim mimmennu — hare zeh pasul bayyom harishon shel chag min hattora, shenneemar "uleqachtem lakem bayyom harishon vego'", vedareshu chakamim "lakem" — "mishshellakem", lehotzi et hashshaul veet haggazul veganub sheeno shello, shehare chayyab lehachaziro libalayv veeno yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim:

Umiyyom sheni (dehaynu beeretz yisrael, abal bechutz laaretz — yitbaer leqamman) vaelak shechiyyub netilat lulab eno ella middibre soperim — adam yotze yede chobato lekattechilla beshaul, dekevan shello tiqqenu ella lezeker lammiqdash — lo hechemiru lipsol et hashshaul, kevan sheen pesulo begupo, shehare hu min kasher, ella sheeno shello:

Umuttar littol lulab shel chabero shello middato ulebarek alayv bishar hayyamim chutz miyyom rishon kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trn"ch, demin hassetam lo yaqpid chabero al zeh, shennoach lo leadam shetteaseh mitzva bemamono bedabar sheen bo chesron kis, shehare en hallulab mitqalqel bekak. Abal asur lehotzi hallulab mimmaqom shehinnicho bealayv lemaqom acher kegon mibbeto lebet hakkeneset, kemo shennitbaer besiman y"d, ayyen sham hattaam:

Abal haggazul vehagganub — ap bishar hayyamim hu pasul, ap al pi shekkebar nityaashu habbealim, lepi shehu mitzva habbaa baabera, kelomar keshehu meqayyem et hammitzva — hu meqayyem otah beissur gazel, shehare im bau habbealim litboa shellahem — chayyab lehachazir lahem haggezela beeneha veeno yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim, venimtza shehaggezela enah qenuya lo kelal vaadayin hi shel hannigzal, veshello kedin hu mishtammesh bah:

Abal im kebar qana haggazlan et haggezela al yede shinnuy, ben sheqqenaah al yede shinnuy maaseh ben sheqqenaah al yede shinnuy hashshem qodem shebba lehishtammesh bah leshem mitzva, kegon sheggazal lulab veshippahu — hare zeh kasher apillu bayyom harishon, dekevan sheapillu im ba hannigzal eno mechuyyab lehachazir lo haggezela atzmah ella damim bilbad hu shechayyab lo, kemo shekkatub bechoshen mishpat siman shn"g — nimtza shehi qenuya legamre lehaggazlan, vahare hi keshello mammash lekol dabar. Umikkol maqom, kevan sheal yede abera baa mitzva zo leyado — lo yebarek aleha apillu miyyom sheni vaelak. Veap sheyyesh choleqim al zeh — sepeq berakot lehaqel, deen zeh mebarek ella menaetz (shennireh kimbarek al abera shennizdammena leyado), im loqecho letzorek atzmo latzet bo:

Vekol zeh begannab vegazlan atzmo, abal im makar o natan bemattana gemura leadam acher, im kebar nityaashu habbealim qodem shemmakar venatan — hare kebar niqnet haggezela lehalloqeach beyeush bealim veshinnuy reshut mehaggazlan lehalloqeach, sheap im ba hannigzal — en halloqeach chayyab lehachazir lo kelum, nimtza shehi qenuya lo legamre, vahare hi keshello mammash lekol dabar, veyotze bah yede chobato ap bayyom harishon, umuttar lo lebarek aleha, shehare lo al yede abera baa mitzva zo leyado, shehare hu lo gazal (vegam qana otah achar shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna). Abal im adayin lo nityaashu habbealim mimmenna — en halloqeach yotze bah yede chobato ap bishar hayyamim, lepi shehi mitzva habbaa baabera, shehare shello kedin mishtammesh bah halloqeach, kevan sheadayin hi bechezqat hannigzal, shehare adayin lo nityaesh mimmenna:

Vekol zeh keshemmakar o natan bemattana gemura, abal im hishilah leacher (o netanah lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, ap al pi shekkebar nityaashu habbealim — en hashshoel yotze bah yede chobato bayyom harishon, shehare enah qenuya lo al yede yeush veshinnuy reshut, veen zeh shinnuy reshut (haggazlan), kevan shehu mechuyyab lehachazirah lehaggazlan, abal bishar hayyamim yotze bah yede chobato, veen kan mitzva habbaa baabera, kevan shekkebar nityaashu habbealim qodem shehishilah lo — nimtza sheen al hashshoel shum avon asher chata):

Yisrael halloqeach minnokri echad mikkol arbaa minim shebbelulab haggadel beqarqao shel hannokri — lo yeqatztzetzennu hayyisrael beatzmo miqqarqao shel hannokri, lepi shessetam nokrim hen gozelim sadot miyyisrael o minnokri acher, veqarqa enah nigzelet, kelomar en aleha torat gazel lihyot omedet bechezqat haggazlan ubirshuto lekol dabar lehitchayyeb beacharayutah, ella leolam hi bechezqat hannigzal ubirshuto lekol dabar, veyisrael zeh haqqotzetz vetolesh miqqarqa zo — hare hu haggozel mibbaal haqqarqa mah shettolesh. Veap al pi shebbaal haqqarqa kebar nityaesh mimmenna, mikkol maqom yeush bilbad belo shinnuy reshut — eno qoneh , vahare hu gazel beyado. Abal im yisrael zeh qotzetz kede limkor o litten laacherim sheyyetzeu bo yede chobatan bechag — hare zeh muttar, shehare yesh kan gam shinnuy reshut mehaggazlan, dehaynu yisrael zeh haqqotzetz lirshut halloqeach:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar qatzatz hayyisrael — muttar hu beatzmo gam ken lebarek alayv, kevan sheqqatzatz birshut hannokri — en anu chosheshin lesapeq, shemma gezula hi beyado miyyisrael o minnokri acher:

Veken im nokri baal haqqarqa shennoten reshut leyisrael liqtzotz hu machaziq qarqa zo miyyad hammelek shennetanah lo, ap al pi shehammelek atzmo kabash qarqa zo bemilchama miyyad acher— en zeh gazel, shehaqqarqa niqnet lehaggazlan bekibbush milchama qinyan gamur, kemo shellamedu chakamim mimmidrash happesuqim. Vekol zeh bechutz laaretz, abal beeretz yisrael shechayyebet bitrumot umaasrot, im qatzatz yisrael beatzmo et haetrog — hare nitchayyeb etrog zeh bitrumot umaasrot al yede qetzitza shel hayyisrael, veim netalo leshem mitzva qodem shehiprish alayv teruma umaaser meetrog acher — lo yatza yede chobato, shehare hu tebel, vetebel pasul apillu bishar hayyamim kemo sheyyitbaer:

Kol arbaat hamminim shehaya echad mehen shel ashera, im hi shel yisrael dehaynu sheqqana otah yisrael miyyad obedeha — hare zeh pasul apillu bishar hayyamim, lepi shekkol hamminim tzarik sheyyihyu keshiuran hamporash bahen (dehaynu shelosha tepachim, ayyen siman tr"n), vaashera shehi shel yisrael kevan sheen bittul hannokrim moil lah lehattirah bahanaa — hare hi omedet lisrepa, vekol haomed lissarep — hare hu kesarup, venimtza sheen bo kashshiur hamporash bo:

Veim haashera hi shel nokri — lekattechilla lo yiqtzotz mimmenna echad mikkol arbaat hamminim, apillu im kebar bittelah hannokri. Vaapillu im ilan hazzeh netauhu shello leshem aboda zara veachar sheggadal abaduhu beinyan shehu muttar bahanaa lehedyot apillu belo bittul, shehamchubbar eno neesar — ap al pi ken hu maus legaboah, kevan shenniqra alayv shem aboda zara. Abal bediabad shekkebar natal arbaa minim shel ashera zo leshem mitzva — yatza yede chobato, veeno tzarik lachazor velittol. Vaapillu im lo bittel hannokri ashera zo vahare hi asura bahanaa, mikkol maqom kevan shemmoil lah bittul lehattirah bahanaa — hare enah omedet lisrepa, sheepshar sheyyebattelennu nokri. Veap al pi sheakshav adayin hi asura bahanaa — en zo chashuba hanaa mah sheyyotze bah yede chobato, demitzvot lav lehanot nittenu kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"v, ayyen sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello nitkavven yisrael zeh sheqqatzatz minim ellu mehaashera lizkot bahen letzorek atzmo, ella haya bedato lehachaziran lehannokri baal haashera bishlemut, velo netalan leshem mitzva bayyom harishon shehare hashshaul pasul bo, ella netalan bishar hayyamim. Abal im nitkavven lizkot bahen legamre shello lehachaziran lehannokri — hare miyyad biqtzitza zo zaka bah hayyisrael venaaset aboda zara shel yisrael, veen bittul hannokri moil lehattirah bahanaa im lo bittelah qodem qetzitzato, vahare hi omedet lisrepa, lepikak apillu bediabad lo yatza:

Vekol zeh bimehem shehannokrim hayu mishtachavim lailan, abal bizman hazzeh sheen hannokrim mishtachavim lailan ella (notein ilan lipne aboda zara o) shennoteim ilanot baggan shel aboda zara udeme perot hailanot hu lekohanehem — muttar liqqach mehen arbaa minim shebballulab, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qm"g leinyan hanaat hedyot, ayyen sham:

Etrog sheeno rauy laakila, kegon shehu shel tebel o shel orla — pasul kol z' yamim, shenneemar "uleqachtem lakem", vedareshu chakamim: harauy lakem lekol darke hanaato, veetrog shedderek hanaato hi haakila — tzarik lihyot rauy laakila. Veetrog shel orlat chutz laaretz, ap al pi sheasur baakila, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh mattirin lehaakil orlat chutz laaretz lachabero sheeno yodea shezzeh orla, veim ken hare hu rauy laakila, veap al pi sheen halaka kedibrehem kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rtz"d, mikkol maqom yesh lismok al dibrehem lehakshir haetrog lammitzva:

Mi shennadar hanaa millulab shello o millulab shel chabero — hare lulab zeh pasul lo bayyom harishon, shehare en lulab zeh rauy lo liklum, kevan shennadar mimmennu hanaa, vehattora omra "lakem" — harauy lakem lekol darke hanaato, ulepikak tzarik liqqach lo lulab acher latzet bo bayyom harishon. Abal bishar hayyamim, kevan sheen chiyyub netilat lulab ella zeker lammiqdash — lo hechemiru kol kak leposlo bedabar sheen happesul begupo, shehare lulab zeh kasher hu beatzmo, ella shehu nadar mimmennu hanaa:

Abal shear kol haddebarim happesulin bekol echad mearbaa minim sheppesulan hu miggupo — posel ben bayyom harishon ben bishar hayyamim, chutz mippesul mechamat chesron kegon niqqab neqeb mepullash veyesh bo chesron miggup haetrog, o shennittal uqtzo venishar meqomo gumma, abal nittela pitmato en pissulo mechamat chesron bilbad ella mechamat sheen zeh hiddur, lepikak pasul kol shibat hayyamim, kishar kol pesulim shemmechamat hiddur kegon chazazit vekayyotze bo shepposelin kol z' yamim:

Vaapillu chesron eno kasher bishar hayyamim ella im ken nishtayyer bo shalem kashshiur, dehaynu kebetza baetrog, abal im lo nishtayyer bo kebetza — pasul. Veken hadas vaaraba sheen bahen kashshiur dehaynu shelosha tepachim, velulab sheen bo kashshiur dehaynu arbaa tepachim — pesulin kol shibat hayyamim:

Nimtzeta lamed, shekkol happesulin barishon min hattora — pesulin bishar hayyamim middibre soperim, chutz min asara debarim veellu hem: a' hashshaul, ben middaat habbealim ben shennatal shello middaat habbealim, abal lo nitkavven ligzol. B' hannoder hanaa millulab uminayv. G' lulab shennisdaq beinyan shennipsal. D' nechleqa aleh haelyon haemtzai (sheshshene pesulim ellu hen mechamat chesron, kemo shennitbaer besiman trm"h). Hashem nikpepu rob rashe healin shebballulab. V' hadas sheyyabeshu alayv venisharu bo shelosha alin kemushin berosh habbad. Z' etrog shenniqqab, apillu yesh bo chesron, vaapillu harbeh yoter mikkeissar, vaapillu hu mepullash. Ch' nimmoq kol besaro mibbipnim. T' nisdaq beinyan shennipsal. Y' nittal uqtzo. Veyesh makshirin bishar hayyamim ap happesul mechamat sheeno hiddur, kegon nittela pitmato vachazazit vekayyotze bahem. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo minim acherim, shehare yesh nohagin lebarek bishat haddechaq al kol happesulin ap beyom rishon kemo sheyyitbaer:

Etrog shenniqqebuhu akbarim, ap al pi shehu kasher bishar hayyamim, shehare hechaser hu kasher bishar hayyamim miyyom sheni vaelak, mikkol maqom lekattechilla lo yittelennu ap bishar hayyamim ad sheyyasir niqqur haakbarim, mishshum mius. Abal im haya pissulo mechamat sheeno hiddur, kegon shehaya yabesh o menummar sheppasul kol shibat hayyamim — en moil lehakshiro al yede sheyyachtok veyasir meqom haybeshut o maqom hamnummar, hoil uba mikkoach pasul. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar miyyom sheni vaelak lachtok min haetrog veleekol, veyotze yede chobato behannotar ap al pi shehu miut shel kol haetrog, ubilbad sheyyihyeh bo kebetza. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehitna alayv qodem ben hashshemashot shel lel rishon, sheeno bodel et atzmo millihyot kocho uzekuto behaetrog kol shehut ben hashshemashot shel lel sheni, denimtza etrog zeh lo huqtza beben hashshemashot shel lel rishon shehu techillat hechag lemitzvat netilat etrog, shehare lishar yeme hechag hitna alayv sheyyehe kocho uzekuto bo bitchillat kenisat shear yeme hechag dehaynu ben hashshemashot shel lel sheni. Abal im lo amar beperush sheeno bodel et atzmo mimmennu kol shehut ben hashshemashot, ap al pi shehitna alayv sheyyehe muttar lehistappeq mimmennu miyyom sheni vaelak — asur lehistappeq mimmennu miyyom sheni vaelak, dekevan shebbeben hashshemashot shel lel rishon shehu techillat kenisat hechag haya muqtzeh veomed lemitzvat netilat etrog shel kol shibat yeme hechag shehaya asur lo lehistappeq mimmennu kol shehut ben hashshemashot shel lel rishon, shehare hu kullo muqtzeh lemitzvato latzet bo lemachar beyom rishon shehechaser pasul bo, vekevan shebben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hechag kol haetrog hu muqtzeh veasur lehistappeq mimmennu apillu mashshehu — hare kullo huqtza veneesar lekol shibat yeme hechag, shekkol shibat hayyamim hen keyom echad arok leinyan zeh min hassetam, ella im ken hitna beperush al shear hayyamim veal derek shennitbaer:

Kol happesulin beyom rishon ukesherim miyyom sheni vaelak — haynu beeretz yisrael sheyyom sheni hu chol hammoed. Ubechutz laaretz sheosin yom tob shene yamim — yesh omerim shekkol happesulin hannohagin barishon min hattora nohagin beyom tob sheni middibre soperim, dekevan shettiqqenu yom tob sheni mippene hassapeq shemma hu yom tob rishon im ken tzarik linhog bo mechamat hassapeq kol hachumrot shel yom tob harishon. Veyesh omerim kevan sheanu beqiim biqbiut hachodesh veyodein anu shehashsheni hu chol, veen anu nohagin bo qodesh ella shello lezalzel beminhag abotenu shehayu bizman shemmeqaddeshin al pi hareiyya, sheaz lo haya haddabar taluy bidiat cheshbon qebiut hechodashim, veen anu metzuvvim ella shello lezalzel beiqqar qedushshat hayyom, ulepikak anu meqaddeshin al hakkos umebarekin zeman beyom tob sheni kemo beyom tob harishon, abal debarim sheenan meiqqar qedushshat hayyom ella shehen mitzvot hannohagot beoto hayyom bilbad, kegon kol happesulin beyom tob harishon bilbad, veap im lo tihyena mitzvot hallalu nohagot beyom tob sheni en kan zilzul leyom tob hashsheni kelal, kevan sheen hammitzvot teluyot beiqqar qedushshat hayyom kelal, shehare mitzvat netilat lulab lo tala hakkatub chiyyubo mechamat shehu yom tob ella mechamat shehu yom harishon, shenneemar "uleqachtem lakem bayyom harishon". Uleinyan halaka — sepeq berakot lehaqel, lepikak kol happesulin barishon — nittalin beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot belo beraka. Umikkol maqom, im epshar yiqqach mechabero lulab uminayv kesherim bemattana al menat lehachazir (kede lachosh lassebara harishona deshaul pasul beyom tob sheni) vibarek alayv, veachar kak yittol et shello (veyomar bo hallel im hatztzibbur):

Kol arbaa minim happesulin upissulan nikkar begupan, kegon sheppesulin mechamat chesron o mechamat hiddur, im hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo minin acherim kesherim — muttar lebarek al minim happesulim ellu apillu bayyom harishon, lepi shekkol pesulim ellu lo nitpareshu heteb bakkatub, ap al pi shekkatub battora "hadar", mikkol maqom lo peresh hakkatub mahu hadar umahu eno hadar, ella kol pesulin ellu mesaran hakkatub lachakamim, vehem ameru shello bishat haddechaq apillu bediabad lo yatza, kede sheyyihyu yisrael zehirim bemitzvot vichazzeru achar minim hakkesherim, abal bishat haddechaq kevan shei epshar beinyan acher — mebarekin al ellu happesulin, shello tishtakkach torat etrog miyyisrael:

Abal kol happesulin mechamat sheenan minan kelal, kegon hadas shoteh vehatztzaptzapa veetrog hammurkab (o mechamat sheen sheman alehem kegon nasheru rob alin), o mechamat shehen chaserin hashshiur, dehaynu etrog pachut mikkebetza velulab pachut mearbaa tepachim vahadas vaaraba pachut mishshelosha tepachim, o mechamat mitzva habbaa baabera, o mechamat aboda zara, o mechamat sheen haetrog rauy laakila — kol ellu en nittalin bishat haddechaq apillu belo beraka, gezera shemma yitu veyomru sheggam minim ellu kesherim hen ulekak hen nittalin veyitu lehakshira[n] ap shello bishat haddechaq. Abal keshehappesul hu mechamat mum sheyyesh bo chesron begupo o sheeno hadar — hakkol roim et hammum, shehehadur vehachesron hu dabar nireh laenayim, vehakkol yodeim sheen makshirin otam ella lepi shehi sheat haddechaq, shehare bishar kol hashshanim machazirin achar shelemim vahadurim. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim, deap happesulin mechamat mum — en mebarekin alehem leet haddechaq, ella notelin otan belo beraka lezikkaron bealma, shello tishtakkach torat etrog. Veyesh meqomot shennohagin kassebara harishona. Ubeellu hammedinot nohagin bekol happesulin kassebara haacharona, chutz min lulab vahadas haybeshim sheim lo hayu mebarekin alehem bishat haddechaq — al harob lo hayu mebarekin kelal al mitzvat lulab, sheen lulabin lachin veen hadassim lachim metzuyim bimdinot ellu:

Venohagin bimdinot ellu lebarek al lulab vahadas yebeshim ap bemaqom sheyyesh acherim lachim bair. Vetaam hamminhag hu, mishshum sheggam hallachim enan lachim gemurim, raq sheyyesh bahem miut lachut, veim ken hallachin vehaybeshin hen domin kimat zeh lazeh. Abal bemaqom sheyyesh lachin gemurin — en lebarek al haybeshin, apillu enan yebeshin gemurim raq yesh bahem miut lachut. Veim abar uberak alehem — yesh lehistappeq velomar detzarik lachazor ulebarek al hallachin, shehare lo hittiru lebarek al hayyabesh ella bishat haddechaq, abal shello bishat haddechaq apillu bediabad lo yatza, vekan shehaya epshar lebarek al hallachin, im ken lo yatza yede chobato bibeshim, umikkol maqom kevan shehaybeshim enan yebeshim gemurim — epshar lomar deyatza bediabad, velaken yittol et hallachin belo beraka. Abal im berak al haybeshim gemurim bemaqom sheyyesh lachin gemurin — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek al hallachin:
